errBadResponseFrom.message: $PROVIDER$ returned an unreadable response. Please try again.

errQuota.message: $PROVIDER$ reports that your account has no remaining credit or quota. Add billing credit with the provider and try again.

errTimeout.message: The AI provider did not respond in time. Please try again.

errNetwork.message: Could not reach the AI provider. Please check your internet connection.

errPassword.message: Phravexa never reads or replaces text in password fields.

errNoSelection.message: Select some text first, then right-click and choose a language, or press the Phravexa shortcut.

errTooLong.message: Please select less text (up to about $COUNT$ characters).

errSetup.message: Add your AI provider and API key in Phravexa settings (click the extension icon).

errClipboard.message: Could not copy the result to the clipboard. Please try again.
